milestones.name: Phase 0 — Foundation
milestones.note: COMPLETE 2026-09-04 (Jon direction). Foundation closed: SOR + schema, migration, immutable audit, RBAC enforcement, local restore-tested backup, and crash/reboot availability all live. CMMC/CUI hosting boundary resolved by keeping HR PII in BambooHR (system of record) via the installed read-only API — MC holds NO CUI/PII, so no Azure Gov compute is required to complete Phase 0. Two hardening legs (remote/offsite backup + Azure Gov/GCC-High CUI-document boundary & warm standby) intentionally deferred to Phase 6 — see Decisions D-002 / D-003.

deliverables.name: CMMC 2.0 / CUI hosting boundary
deliverables.note: RESOLVED 2026-09-04 (Jon direction): HR PII stays in BambooHR (system of record) accessed through the installed, functional read-only BambooHR API. MC holds NO CUI/HR PII, so no Azure Gov compute is required for HR PII go-live — this unblocks Phase 0. MC must hold no ITAR/CUI technical data (incl. payload tech data) until that enclave exists.

milestones.name: Phase 2 — Timekeeping (Bamboo/DCAA) → MC Cost Accounting
milestones.note: 2026-10-01: Jon handed Phase 2 to Exo; approvals go to Jon as Decisions D-7281877 (policy EXOS-FIN-002-0), D-7281878 (who completes the Bamboo admin setup), D-7281879 (cost-code structure + approver map), D-7281880 (total-time scope). Live 10/1 pull: Sept 1,216 hrs / 201 entries, 8 of 12 clocking, ~86% of hours carry no project, no cost-code tasks, Hermes 8.4 hrs. Decision 2026-07-30: timekeeping lives in BAMBOO — projects structured to the DCAA-required format, employees book time under DCAA cost codes, Bamboo object-lock = immutability. Fixed-Price (FFP) is the primary vehicle, which limits the DCAA compliance burden. MC does NOT build timekeeping; it reads Bamboo actuals for cost rollup.

deliverables.name: DCAA timekeeping (in Bamboo — projects + cost codes + object-lock)
deliverables.owner: Exo (drive) + Jon/Lizi admin login per D-7281878; Kyle = policy/indirect-rate owner
deliverables.note: 2026-10-01: Exo took over (stalled with Kyle since 9/7, due 9/12). Gated by D-7281878 + D-7281879. Task #1870. PLAN SET 2026-09-05 (Jon): Exo does the Bamboo setup via admin login at ExoMac; PILOT = Project Hermes (FA9300-25-C-6022) to prove the system before any DCAA-required contract. Staged: DCAA Timekeeping Policy procedure EXOS-FIN-002-0, Hermes pilot setup sheet, employee quick-start, team announcement (#2657). Lizi to schedule the ExoMac session (#2656). TURNKEY CONFIG SPEC delivered 2026-09-04 (attached to #1870): Projects = contracts (FA9300-25-C-6022, Karmen D2P2) + indirect pools (OH/G&A/B&P/IR&D) + leave; Tasks = WBS cost codes; total-time accounting, supervisor approval (no self-approval), object-lock. ~30-60 min admin-console work. API canNOT create these (admin-only). DECISION for Jon: Lizi/Kyle configure vs. give Exo an admin login to drive the UI. FFP-primary limits mandatory scope.

deliverables.name: Azure Gov / GCC-High CUI-document enclave + warm standby
deliverables.note: Deferred from Phase 0 (Decision D-002). INTERIM CONTROL SET 2026-09-05 (Jon): CUI/ITAR/EAR documents are stored in SharePoint (GCC High) under manual procedure SEC-CUI-STOR (Process Library) — any CUI task completes that procedure and is confirmed done in MC; MC records ONLY a reference + approved-access SharePoint link, never the file or its content. MC stays CUI/PII-free. The Azure Gov / GCC-High enclave (this deliverable) later AUTOMATES that manual control; it is required only if/when MC must hold controlled docs directly. Also provides the Azure Gov warm standby for availability.
